empty.title: No devices yet

revoke.title: Revoke this token?
revoke.description: {name} stops working at once. Any shortcut or script that uses it gets an authorization error until you give it a new token.

create.title: Create ingest token
create.description: Name the token after what will use it, so you can tell tokens apart later.
create.namePlaceholder: Enter a name, for example iPhone shortcut
create.nameRequired: Enter a name for the token.

secret.title: Your new token
secret.description: Copy the token now and keep it somewhere safe.
secret.warning: You won't see this token again. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
secret.label: Token

applePay.title: Apple Pay
applePay.description: Log every Apple Pay payment in MoneyMatter the moment you tap, without typing anything. An iOS Shortcut sends each payment here, and MoneyMatter files it on the account linked to the card.
applePay.manualGuide: Prefer to build the shortcut by hand? Follow the {link}.

setup.title: One-tap setup
setup.description: Generate a setup code, add the MoneyMatter shortcut to your iPhone and paste the code when the shortcut asks for it. The code carries a new token, so nothing else needs to be typed.
setup.revokePrevious: Revoke the previous Apple Pay token
setup.revokePreviousHint: The shortcut that uses the old token stops working until you set it up again with the new code.
setup.generateError: Could not generate the setup code
setup.addShortcutHint: Copy the setup code first. The shortcut asks for it once, when you add it.
setup.shortcutUnavailable: This instance does not ship the shortcut file. Build the shortcut by hand with the manual guide below, or ask the administrator for the shortcut link.

accessHeaders.title: Cloudflare Access (optional)
accessHeaders.description: Fill these in only if a service such as Cloudflare Access sits in front of this instance and asks for a login before it lets requests through. The shortcut then sends the service token's Client ID and Client secret as the CF-Access-Client-Id and CF-Access-Client-Secret headers, and the setup code carries them. If nothing protects your instance, leave both empty.
accessHeaders.clientIdPlaceholder: Enter the service token's Client ID
accessHeaders.clientSecretPlaceholder: Enter the service token's Client secret
accessHeaders.clientSecretStoredPlaceholder: Stored. Enter a new secret to replace it
accessHeaders.statusConfigured: Stored for the setup code: Client ID {hint}
accessHeaders.statusNotConfigured: Not set. The setup code will carry no Cloudflare Access headers.
accessHeaders.bothRequired: Enter both the Client ID and the Client secret, or leave both empty.
accessHeaders.saveError: Could not save the Cloudflare Access headers
accessHeaders.loadError: Could not load the Cloudflare Access headers.

codeDialog.title: Your setup code
codeDialog.description: Copy the code, tap Add Shortcut and paste the code when the shortcut asks for it. To set up another phone, scan the QR code and copy the text it shows.
codeDialog.warning: You won't see this code again. It holds a token that can add payments to your account, so don't share it. If you lose it, generate a new one.
codeDialog.qrLabel: QR code of the setup code

checklist.title: Then create the automation on your iPhone
checklist.description: iOS does not let apps share automations, so this part is done on the phone itself.
checklist.step1: Open Shortcuts, go to Automation, tap + and choose Transaction.
checklist.step2: Choose your cards, select Run Immediately and tap Next.
checklist.step3: Select the shortcut "MoneyMatter - Log card payment" and tap Done.
checklist.test: Run the shortcut by hand from the Shortcuts app. Without a payment it sends a test request and shows a notification that confirms the connection.

cardLinks.description: Apple Wallet gives each card a name. Link that name to the account its payments should be logged on. A payment from a card without a link waits until you link it.

applePay.limitation: Only contactless taps in a shop start the shortcut. Apple Pay payments inside apps and on websites do not trigger the Wallet automation, so log them by hand or connect your bank to bring them in with the bank sync.
